iiNet questions

What is the cheapest iiNet NBN plan?

NBN25 NBN 25/10 at $59.99/mo for 12 months, then $79.99/mo. That is $719.88 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does iiNet let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. iiNet only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give iiNet 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. iiNet asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.
